title: An egocentric point of view, built in posteromedial cortex

statements.text: Posteromedial cortices receive the upper levels of each sensory hierarchy along with position and head direction, which organizes perception into egocentric reference frames. A stable source of egocentric perspective may be a practically necessary precondition for there being something that it is like.
